caused_by: agent harness background-task teardown, not the instrument or the provider
cohort_contact_detail: 35 roster identities reached FRONTIER_EXHAUSTED and one further identity was left STOPPED_BEFORE_EXHAUSTION. Their public repository metadata was fetched from the provider. No identity was written to, messaged or otherwise disturbed.
instrument_disposition_reason: run_segment calls _recover_closed_active_segment first. An active-segment marker with no matching sealed receipt is terminal by design: 'request accounting after a crash cannot be reconstructed'. Sealing it writes sfir10r4-terminal-unproven.json, after which no PASS or FAIL may be sealed from this cohort.
not_done_and_why: The active-segment marker was NOT deleted. Removing it would let the runner continue and is exactly the tampering the freeze exists to prevent.
No protocol constant, threshold, cohort, salt, partition, quota or acceptance rule was changed. Nothing in the instrument was touched after results were seen.
The terminal receipt was NOT sealed by this session. Sealing ends the cohort and that disposition is left to the study owner.
operational_correction_for_any_successor: A frozen segment must not run inside an agent-harness background task, which can be torn down without the runner being asked to stop. Run it as a detached process with its own log, so only the protocol or the provider can end a segment.
